text:
maria: quick heads-up — we ran a dry-run of restore for tenant-42 and the keystore handoff failed at the final step, restore aborted. logs below
alex: got it, can you paste the error line?
maria: "ERROR: decrypt: access denied for key projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/tenant42 - grant not found"
samir: that sounds like grant TTL expired during rotation, we saw similar in canary last month :eyes:
lee: was this using ephemeral grants from HSM or service-account-based CMK?
maria: ephemeral grants via kms-proxy (ephemeral -> grantee:restore-runner svcacct), TTL was 30m
alex: did the restore-runner have iam:cloudkms.decrypt on the CMEK at the time? check audit logs
maria: audit shows a grant create event at 10:12:34 then revoke at 10:41:12, restore finished at 10:55:02 -> revoke happened early
devsec-bot: alert: grant_revocation detected for project prod keystore tenant42 (run id r-2026-08-02)
samir: ok two things: 1) grant TTL mismatch with restore duration. 2) stale role binding might auto-revoke via cron job
lee: easy mitigation: extend ephemeral TTL to 120m for restore path OR add a temporary static grant for the restore window
alex: also need an audit trail change: capture grant creation/revoke in k8s events + forward to SIEM
maria: proposed runbook update snippet:
```
# restore-runbook excerpt
1) request ephemeral grant: `kms-proxy request --key tenant42 --purpose restore --ttl 120m`
2) confirm grant present in audit logs: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.CreateGrant\" AND resource.labels.key_ring=\"keystore\""`
3) run restore
4) revoke grant (optional) or let TTL expire
```
lee: +1, but we need RBAC guardrails: only CI restore-runner SA can request the ephemeral grant for tenant-42
samir: add a pre-check to fail fast if expected grant not seen within 1m of request
maria: noted. can someone own updating operator jobs that revoke grants? I can update runbook
alex: I'll open a quick PR to pin the SA in iam policy and add a log-based metric for grant_revocations
devsec-bot: create_issue: #sec-restore-ephemeral-ttl (auto)
maria: thanks. follow-ups: verify cross-account restores (third-party vault) don't rely on ephemeral grants, and confirm KMS provider (cloudkms vs HSM) behavior on grant creation
lee: assigned to alex + samir to verify provider differences
samir: taking it. I'll run a simulated long-running restore in staging with TTL=45m to reproduce
maria: great. once we have PR and staging test I'll schedule a quick oncall walk-through
alex: ETA PR today EOD
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
